description: A coordinated series of micro-outages in municipal power grids across Southern and Eastern Europe — initially dismissed as maintenance failures — are retrospectively linked to AI-guided probing by an unattributed actor. The pattern suggests a distributed, low-intensity campaign to map critical infrastructure resilience, exploiting open-weight models for adaptive penetration. The incidents do not trigger major disruption but reveal systemic fragility, prompting emergency NATO consultations on AI-enabled hybrid warfare.
